# Swayam Prajapat — Full-Stack Developer

> Swayam Prajapat is a full-stack software developer with 3 years of professional experience building high-performance web software, scalable backends, and responsive user interfaces. Core technical strengths include React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.

## Projects

- [Fetchmate](https://www.swayam.cyou/projects/fetchmate): Two-sided pet care marketplace connecting owners with verified sitters. Features include real-time booking workflows, availability management, and Stripe payment processing. Built with Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, and Stripe.
- [ChatZapp](https://www.swayam.cyou/projects/chatzapp): High-concurrency real-time messaging application supporting instant message delivery, user channels, and responsive UI design.
- [Eleve](https://www.swayam.cyou/projects/eleve): Modern web experience emphasizing fluid animations, responsive layouts, and clean interface aesthetics.

## Writing & Articles

- [A Box That Controls the World](https://www.swayam.cyou/blog/a-box-that-controls-the-world): Analysis of computing hardware, system architectures, and digital control mechanisms.
- [Evolution of Computers Part 1](https://www.swayam.cyou/blog/evolution-of-computers-1): Historical and engineering overview of modern computing architecture.
